text: Planning a trip is half the fun for me. I spend weeks researching destinations, booking flights, and creating a loose itinerary. However, the real magic happens when I arrive. Experiencing a new culture is like opening a door to a different world. I love wandering through local markets, trying street food I can't pronounce, and getting lost in unfamiliar neighborhoods. Of course, language barriers can be tricky, but a smile and a translation app usually solve most problems. These challenges often lead to the funniest stories. In the end, it’s not the perfect photos but the unexpected moments and the people I meet that become the memories I cherish forever.
